utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Eli — I’ve got the rest covered and should have the gear ready for the repair drive. See you at the community center at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I can help keep an eye on the list if you want.

utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — that’d be great. I’ll keep updating the list, and if you hear of any supplies Quinn still needs, just pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s still happening today, and it sounds like it’s coming together nicely. Folks are already dropping off tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to hear — do you need any help with sorting or hauling anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful if you can help! Sorting would be especially useful, and maybe a hand hauling the heavier boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’m set for now, thanks. I’ll keep spreading the word about the 10 AM repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mina — I’ll do that and keep inviting folks. See you at the community center at 10!

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll see you at the community shed at 9 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The main thing left is checking in with folks and making sure everyone knows where to go for the repair drive. I can help keep track of who’s coming if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help a lot—thanks. I can keep checking in with people and make sure they know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — I’ll drop by soon with the list. Really appreciate you being ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll swing by soon with the list, Sam — thanks again for being ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just let me know if you need me after 5.

utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly worried about the timing and whether we’ve got the supplies sorted. Can you remind me what’s still outstanding?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, sorry — I can help check what’s left on the timing and supplies if you remind me what we’ve already got.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s coming together nicely — Mina’s bringing the flashlight and gloves, Faye’s helping with the school schedule, Cleo’s keeping the list updated, and Leo’s got filler and curb tools at 10. If you want, I can send you the full checklist too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help — I’m a little behind, so the full checklist would be great.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the timing and who’s bringing what, so I don’t miss anything. Did we settle on Saturday afternoon at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, good — I just wanted to make sure I had the time and place right. Let me know once the bring list is set so I can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — could you tell me the main items first, and let me know if the timing changes again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — the main items are tools, batteries, light bulbs, tape, and any small hardware fixes folks can bring. And I’ll let you know right away if the timing changes again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot, thanks — I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center and those main items.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check in with a few folks and keep the Sunday community center plan moving—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Start with Noah and Tess—they already seem in the loop. If you hear what still needs doing, I can help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll check in with Noah and Tess first and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now, and I’m still keeping the supplies list updated.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll be ready to help at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—people are already dropping off tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes—last I heard, it got moved to Sunday at the community center. Sounds like folks are already getting things together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great—Sunday at the community center sounds much easier to coordinate. I’ll keep spreading the word so folks know where to bring everything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No trouble — we’re set for 10 AM at the community center, and I’ll bring the gloves and screwdriver. Just bring the rest of the gear and we’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, that still means today at 10 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, today at 10 AM at the community center — that’s still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on Saturday morning. I can bring a few tools and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. Do you still need any other supplies from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: If you’ve got extra screws, tape, or a couple extension cords, that’d be a big help. Otherwise, I’ve got the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I heard the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works better for me. What time should I plan around, and should I bring any supplies?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m checking on the time now — I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. If you can, bring gloves and a few basic tools just in case.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks, Uli — I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help once you point me to the list of basics.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Oren — I’ll send over the basics now, and you can take the next item when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — send the list when you can, and I’ll take the next basic task.
